final: WITH eligible AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.ID FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-')), per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN eligible e ON e.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT p.SEX, AVG(pp.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(pp.avg_ratio) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n_patients FROM per_patient pp JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = pp.ID GROUP BY p.SEX
